decisions.reason: Premium customer support is tightly aligned with the firm's core hosting and agency-service capabilities, so its existing knowledge base and service organisation make continued improvement and commercialization likely.

The software version management tool builds directly on the firm's hosting, maintenance and in-house development competences, which gives it good absorptive capacity to refine the product even if it is somewhat more specialised than core support services.

The data processing contract tool is comparatively distant from the firm's established technical hosting know-how, so despite some fit with customer needs it is harder for the firm to learn about, improve and scale relative to more related offerings.

Scalable hosting for agencies is very close to the firm's established business and was highlighted as a strategic flagship, making it the kind of product the firm is best equipped to absorb, develop and retain.
